items.title: Keith Ingham interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: And you ever heard that piano player with Mahalia Jackson? Mildred Falls? You ever seen that Mahalia Jackson “Jazz on a Summer’s Day?”

ctx.x: Thank you. One of my favorite piano players, Ray Bryant, he used to do that stuff. His sister was a wonderful, I believe, Gospel player, played in church, a pianist. And you ever heard that piano player with Mahalia Jackson? Mildred Falls? You ever seen that Mahalia Jackson “Jazz on a Summer’s Day?”
